caseNameFull: Amara, Individually and on Behalf of All Others Similarly Situated v. CIGNA Corp.

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. The Court vacated the judgment below in CIGNA Corp. v. Amara, ante, p. 421. Therefore, certiorari granted, and case remanded for further proceedings.

Justice Sotomayor *1005took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
